definitions.explanation: The hair that grows in the armpit area.

examples.japanese: {脇毛|わきげ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{剃|そ}る→剃る：00384_soru⟧。
⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{脇毛|わきげ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気|き}になる→気になる：03027_kininaru⟧。
examples.english: When summer comes, I start worrying about dealing with my armpit hair.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{脇毛|わきげ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処理|しょり}する→処理する：25531_shorisuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧や⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧さまざまだ。
examples.english: In Japan, it is common for women to remove their armpit hair, but attitudes vary depending on the country and culture.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{脇|わき}→脇：03790_waki⟧ (armpit, side) and {毛|げ} (hair). A straightforward body-related vocabulary word. In Japan, hair removal (⟦{脱毛|だつもう}→脱毛：24914_datsumou⟧) is a major industry, and {脇毛|わきげ} processing is one of the most common services at hair removal salons.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {脇毛|わきげ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{剃|そ}る→剃る：00384_soru⟧: to shave armpit hair
- {脇毛|わきげ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧: armpit hair removal/grooming
- {脇毛|わきげ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{脱毛|だつもう}→脱毛：24914_datsumou⟧: armpit hair depilation
- {脇毛|わきげ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|は}える→生える：02392_haeru⟧: armpit hair grows

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {腋毛|えきもう}: armpit hair — the formal/medical term using on'yomi readings
- ⟦{体毛|たいもう}→体毛：20542_taimou⟧: body hair — the general term for hair on the body
- {脛毛|すねげ}: leg hair; shin hair — another common body hair term
- {胸毛|むなげ}: chest hair — hair on the chest
